tooling.message:
test: generated apps' end-to-end tests run with one worker inside the tooling's tests

## Intent

The tooling's tests check many apps at the same time, and their browsers compete for the cores. A click lost under that load is the likeliest cause of the one quiz test that failed and could not be reproduced.

## Key changes

- The shared Playwright setup reads LERNAPPS_PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS; the tooling's test harness sets it to 1 for the processes it starts.
- A creator's own check and CI keep running fully parallel on 75% of the cores.
